Name: Xiddav's Natatorium (indoor pool)
Author: xiddav
Description:
Robin can now build a Natatorium for your farm.
Natatorium means a building with an indoor pool.


The prices are configurable
default: 10,000G & 300 wood

the building uses the Big Shed, so mods that change the big shed's appearance will also change the Natatorium.
You can paint the Natatorium just like the Big Sheds to make it stand out from your other sheds.

Manifest.Name: Xiddav's Natatorium
Manifest.Description: Adds a building with a Natatorium that can be built by robin
